children: Incluvie reminded me that representation is not a layer added at the end. It has to shape the content, hierarchy, and product decisions from the start.
I like turning messy product constraints into systems teams can actually use. The small decisions—states, spacing, naming, and behavior—are usually where consistency is won.
I like turning messy product constraints into systems teams can actually use. The small decisions—states, spacing, naming, and behavior—are usually where consistency is won.
I’m exploring AI and spatial interfaces through hands-on product work, especially where new interaction models can make complex tools easier to use.

The future of design isn’t just on screens. It will surround us. AI and XR are where interfaces disappear and experiences evolve. I’m investing in it, learning it, and building for the future I want to help shape.
